notes.title: Add multiplayer mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022577/93a5338c8b22d0d762c23913e7909b2df9ede129.png[/img]

1. Add multiplayer mode to achieve "friends climbing together"
(If friends play at the same time, they can see each other)
Combined with the Steam friend panel, it is possible to play climbing while having voice chat
2. Fix the "grip bug" to make the grip more precise
3. Grip prompt sound effect is more real-time
4. Fix the phenomenon of "mold piercing BUG"

notes.title: Update virtual hand and add "grabable" indicator light
notes.content:
1. Update the latest virtual hand by adding a middle indicator light that indicates that the yellow light is not grabable and the green light is grabable.
2. Increase environmental city and wind sound effects.
3. Add operation prompt text to the initial level
4. Improve walking and movement methods
